scenarios.title: Repair an engineering revision escape
scenarios.intentionalFault: The new Control Plan revision retains a downstream Process Flow and PPFMEA from the prior drawing revision.
scenarios.restoration: Restore the downstream revision and child-table snapshots captured by setup evidence.

scenarios.title: Teach the customized workflow with human approval
scenarios.intentionalFault: A demo record is valid but has not completed the next customer-specific business step.
scenarios.restoration: Restore the namespaced record to its pre-guidance workflow state.

scenarios.title: Repair a customization under role-bound approval
scenarios.intentionalFault: A namespaced validation script incorrectly rejects a valid revised operation.
scenarios.restoration: Restore the namespaced script from its verified before-hash.

scenarios.title: Escalate a v15 to v16 migration failure
scenarios.intentionalFault: A namespaced script or report references a removed v15 schema surface.
scenarios.restoration: Keep the namespaced legacy reference for repeat recording and delete only the approved demo support ticket afterward.
